description: SvDateRangeInput, a compact start and end field for Svelte 5 that opens a portalled two-month range calendar with one-click presets such as Today, Last 7 days and This month. It composes the same headless range engine as SvCalendar and carries the shared editor contract: label, hint, error validation, dir for RTL and localizable messages, with firstDayOfWeek and presets as props.

faq.question: How is this different from SvCalendar in range mode?
faq.answer: SvCalendar renders inline; SvDateRangeInput is a text field that opens the calendar on demand, which suits forms and filter bars where space is tight.

faq.question: How do I add presets?
faq.answer: Pass presets as an array of { label, range } entries or use the built-in set; each one fills the start and end in one click and resolves relative to today.

faq.question: Does it support right-to-left?
faq.answer: Yes. Set dir='rtl' and the field, the dropdown and the month order mirror, and the messages prop lets you localize the preset labels and validation text.
